recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if future publisher/build evidence shows active profile spreadsheets under source/datatypes can no longer be processed.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive DSTU1 issue reported that the profile spreadsheet first-row Type handling always looked for a Resource and did not allow profiling datatypes outside resources.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-3801/GForge #3801 source commit was found. The Jira comments record that Lloyd McKenzie had already completed and propagated the fix, and later source history preserved datatype-area profile spreadsheet inputs.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively registers elementdefinition-11179 from source/datatypes/elementdefinition-11179-profile-spreadsheet.xml, and source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml references that profile spreadsheet from the ElementDefinition datatype source. Searches found no Zulip or Confluence evidence that reverses the Jira disposition.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The current build-facing source already includes datatype-hosted profile spreadsheet support, so changing core source now would be redundant and risk altering unrelated legacy spreadsheet boilerplate.
